title: Cloud DevOps Lead
description:
**Company:** Solutionara Private Limited  
**Location:** Noida, Sector 62, Uttar Pradesh  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Work Model:** On\-site  
**Experience:** 6–10 years

Job Description

Solutionara is looking for a **hands\-on Cloud DevOps Lead** to join our Global Delivery Center in Noida.

This is a technical leadership role for an experienced Cloud/DevOps engineer who can **design and build AWS infrastructure, automate environments using Terraform, work hands\-on with Kubernetes/EKS and CI/CD, troubleshoot production issues, and guide other engineers**.

This is **not a people\-management\-only role**. You will remain hands\-on while taking technical ownership from architecture and infrastructure design through deployment and production operations.

Solutionara is a U.S.\-based IT Consulting and Technology Services firm supporting enterprise clients through its Noida Global Delivery Center.

What You'll Do

* Design, build and manage secure, scalable and highly available **AWS infrastructure**.
* Own AWS architecture across compute, networking, storage, security, monitoring, backup and disaster recovery.
* Design AWS networking including **VPCs, subnets, routing, security groups and load balancers**.
* Build and maintain infrastructure using **Terraform and Infrastructure as Code**.
* Develop reusable Terraform modules, infrastructure templates and automation.
* Design and improve **CI/CD pipelines** using GitHub Actions, Jenkins and/or GitLab CI/CD.
* Deploy and operate containerized workloads using **Docker and Kubernetes**, with AWS EKS preferred.
* Work with Helm, GitOps and ArgoCD where applicable.
* Establish monitoring, logging and alerting using tools such as **CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus, ELK or Datadog**.
* Troubleshoot complex AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure, deployment and production issues and lead RCA.
* Review infrastructure designs, Terraform configurations, pipelines and deployment approaches.
* Guide Cloud/DevOps engineers and establish reusable engineering standards.
* Work directly with architects, engineering teams, project managers and client stakeholders.
* Use AI\-assisted engineering and automation tools to improve troubleshooting, documentation and operational efficiency.

The full role specifically places responsibility on the Lead for technical ownership, architecture reviews, Terraform/CI/CD reviews, reusable engineering standards and mentoring—not simply operational support.

What We're Looking For

**Must Have**

* 6–10 years of relevant Cloud/DevOps engineering experience.
* Strong **hands\-on AWS** experience.
* Strong AWS infrastructure and networking knowledge.
* Hands\-on **Terraform** experience.
* Strong **Docker and Kubernetes** experience.
* Experience designing and implementing **CI/CD pipelines**.
* Strong Linux knowledge.
* Experience with monitoring and observability.
* Python, Bash or PowerShell scripting.
* Strong production troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Demonstrated technical ownership of Cloud/DevOps solutions.
* Ability to review technical work and guide other engineers.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.

These requirements directly reflect the attached JD.

Strongly Preferred

* Hands\-on **AWS EKS** experience.
* Helm, ArgoCD or GitOps.
* Reusable Terraform module development.
* Platform engineering experience.
* AWS Solutions Architect and/or AWS DevOps certification.
* CKA/CKAD.
* Experience supporting U.S. or global clients.
* IT consulting, technology services or enterprise delivery experience.
* Exposure to AI/ML infrastructure or AIOps.

What Success Looks Like

You will help Solutionara build more reliable and scalable AWS platforms, increase infrastructure automation, strengthen Kubernetes and DevOps engineering standards, improve production troubleshooting, and reduce manual operational effort through reusable automation and Infrastructure as Code.

Why Join Solutionara?

Work on enterprise cloud modernization and platform engineering programs for global clients while remaining close to the technology. You'll work with **AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, automation, observability and AI\-assisted engineering**, with opportunities to grow toward Cloud Architect, Platform Engineering Lead, Principal Engineer or Solution Architect responsibilities.

**Important:** This is a **full\-time, on\-site position in Sector 62, Noida.** 

Pay: ₹1,600,000\.00 \- ₹2,600,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Noida, Uttar Pradesh: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Application Question(s):

* Current CTC
* Expected CTC
* Notice Period, if serving, last day of work
* Do you have hands\-on experience designing and building production AWS infrastructure using Terraform, including VPC/networking, IAM/security, and Kubernetes/EKS?
* Have you personally worked on a production workload migration to AWS, including migration planning/dependency assessment and cutover or post\-migration validation?

Work Location: In person

title: Track Manager - Azure DevOps, Terraform
description:
Track Manager \- Azure DevOps, Terraform
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
**Job Summary**
---------------


This role oversees the operational management and enhancement of large\-scale Azure environments, leveraging Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform and automation tools to drive service excellence. The individual ensures robust delivery of client SLAs, implements continuous improvement initiatives, and empowers teams through expert guidance and strategic problem\-solving in cloud operations.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


1\. Lead operations management by implementing advanced DevOps automation using Terraform and Azure DevOps, ensuring high availability and compliance of Azure IaaS, PaaS, and Kubernetes resources.
  

2\. Drive process improvements by designing and optimizing workflows with Infrastructure as Code tools, such as Terraform and Azure Resource Manager, to streamline provisioning and management of cloud assets.
  

3\. Ensure robust support and incident resolution for Azure environments by utilizing monitoring and troubleshooting tools, maintaining SLAs, and providing escalation support for complex issues.
  

4\. Mentor and empower team members on best practices in IaC, Terraform modules, and Azure DevOps pipelines, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and operational excellence.
  

5\. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to gather requirements, translate them into technical solutions using Azure and Terraform, and ensure delivery aligns with organizational and client objectives.
  

6\. Innovate by researching, evaluating, and integrating emerging DevOps tools and Azure services, recommending solutions that enhance operational efficiency and security.
  

7\. Champion continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing operational data, identifying areas for automation, and leading the adoption of new processes or technologies.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Excellent Knowledge Of Azure Iaas, Paas, And Azure Kubernetes Service (Aks) For Deploying And Managing Scalable Solutions.
  

2\. Advanced Skills In Infrastructure As Code (Iac) Practices, Including Terraform Scripting, Module Development, And State Management.
  

3\. Strong Experience With Azure Devops For Ci/Cd Pipeline Creation, Release Management, And Operational Monitoring.
  

4\. InDepth Understanding Of Cloud Security, Governance, And Compliance Frameworks Within Azure.
  

5\. Excellent ProblemSolving And Process Optimization Abilities, With A Track Record Of Leading Operational Improvements.
  

6\. Strong Communication And Mentoring Skills For Leading Technical Teams And Driving Knowledge Transfer.  

  

  

**Other Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Optional but valuable: Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert

title: DevOps Engineer - Noida
description:
**Role \-** **DevOps Enginee**r

**Location:** India \- Noida

**Type:** Full\-time

**Department:** R\&D

**About NeoXam**


NeoXam is a leading B2B fintech software vendor serving buy\-side investment managers and asset servicers globally. Our platform covers data management, reconciliation, fund accounting, reporting, and portfolio management. As we scale, we are investing in the reliability, automation, and security of the infrastructure and delivery pipelines that power our platform.

**The Role**


We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to own the design, automation, and reliability of our cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines.


The problem space is clear: engineering teams need fast, safe, and repeatable ways to build, test, and ship software across multiple products and client environments. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with end\-to\-end ownership, from infrastructure design to production operations. As the initiative matures, you will have the opportunity to shape standards adopted across engineering.

**What You Will Work On**

* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines that support multiple engineering teams and products
* Provision and manage cloud infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent) across environments
* Deploy, operate, and scale containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes
* Build monitoring, logging, and alerting systems that give engineering and support teams real visibility into production health
* Automate configuration management, release processes, and routine operational tasks to reduce manual toil
* Define and enforce security, access control, and secrets management practices across the infrastructure (DevSecOps)
* Continuously improve system reliability, deployment speed, and cost efficiency based on real usage and incidents

**What We Are Looking For**

* 3\-7 years of DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering experience
* Must have hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Strong scripting ability in Python, Bash, or Go for automation
* Hands\-on experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools, Terraform preferred
* Solid understanding of CI/CD tools and practices (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent)
* Experience with configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef, or Puppet)
* Working knowledge of monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Datadog, or equivalent)
* Solid Linux system administration and networking fundamentals (DNS, load balancing, VPC,firewalls)
* Comfortable working end\-to\-end autonomously, from design to production operations

**Who You Are**

* A builder, energized by improving systems that other teams depend on
* Pragmatic, you pick the right tool, not the flashiest one
* Autonomous, you drive toward outcomes without waiting to be told what to do next
* Detail\-oriented, you take reliability and security seriously

**Why Join**

* Ownership of infrastructure and delivery pipelines that power a global fintech platform
* Direct visibility with engineering leadership on architecture decisions
* Path to growing scope and influence as the initiative matures
